_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Chemical and Physical Properties for Forgings Analysis Report
summary: Provides information on the chemical composition and mechanical properties of forgings.
use_relationship:
The Chemical and Physical Properties for Forgings Analysis Report provides information on the chemical composition and mechanical properties of forgings.
a. This DID satisfies the requirements of paragraph 3.13 of MIL-DTL-46172.
b. This DID supersedes DI-FORG-81196.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference Documents.
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Chemical and Physical Properties for Forgings Analysis Report format shall be contractor selected. Unless a specific format is essential for compatibility, the initially used format arrangement by the contractor shall be used for all subsequent submissions.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The Chemical and Physical Properties for Forgings Analysis Report content shall contain the data elements listed within the included figure 1 sample as follows. The figure 1 sample format is not mandatory, and contractors may use their own preferred data listing formats provided all required data elements are present.

children.title: General Information.
children.content: The report shall include the RECORD OF TREATMENT AND TEST OF (enter appropriate identification), Contract (name and address of contractor), Contract order No., Date, Specification No., Drawing number, Forging No., Heat No., Date Forged, Shipped To (Released), and Date Shipped, Released.

children.title: Chemical Analysis.
children.content: The report shall list the complete Obtained and Required chemical composition (C - carbon, Mn - manganese, P - phosphorus, S - sulfur, Si - silicon, Ni - nickel, Cr - chromium, Mo - molybdenum, V - vanadium, blank - other) of the forging.

children.title: Physical Information.
children.content: The report shall include Macroetch satisfactory, Macroetch not taken, Cold Worked and Soaked, Not Cold Worked, Ingot No., Type of Ingot, Ingot Size, Length (inches) Total Weight, Wt. (weight) Above Piece, Wt. (weight) Below Piece, Date Forged.

children.title: Heat Treatment Procedure.
children.content: The report shall include a complete and detailed description of the heat treatment procedure including the date completed.

children.title: Mechanical Properties.
children.content: The report shall include specimen locations, Y.S. (yield strength), T.S. (tensile strength), Elon Percent (percent elongation), R.A. (reduction of area), Hardness, Fracture, and Charpy (ft-lb) values.

children.title: Authentication.
children.content: The Chemical and Physical Properties for Forgings Analysis Report must include identification of the person performing the physical tests (PHYSICAL TESTS MADE BY) and must be signed by the appropriate government inspector with the place and date identified.
